test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the salaries of Abhi and Monu is 6 ∶ 11. If their salaries are increased by 10 per cent and 12 per cent, respectively, then what will be the new ratio of their salaries?
solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the salaries of Abhi and Monu is 6 ∶ 11. 

Their salaries are increased by 10 per cent and 12 per cent

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Let the salary of Abhi be 600 and that of Monu be 1100 then

[600(1 + 10%)] ÷ [1100(1 + 12%)]

⇒ [600(1 + 0.10)] ÷ [1100(1 + 0.12)]

⇒ [600(1.10%)] ÷ [1100(1.12)]

⇒ [660] ÷ [1232]

⇒ 15/28 or 15 : 28

**∴ The new ratio of their salaries is 15 : 28.**

b6
